relations: Flames above the crossed logs continuously deform, split, and recombine as the fire burns.
Bright embers detach from the flame tips and drift upward over the hearth.
The crossed logs and brick walls remain stationary while the fire continues to burn.
Overall flame brightness remains steady without obvious fading or ramping up.
caption: The video captures the interior of a brick fireplace where an active fire is already burning and continues to burn throughout the clip. Several logs lie crossed and stacked along the hearth, their surfaces glowing a deep orange-red, while bright yellow-orange flames rise above them against a dark maroon brick back wall. The flames continuously deform, individual tongues of fire changing height, leaning sideways, splitting into separate tips, and recombining from one moment to the next. A tall central flame flickers alongside shorter side flames, and small bright points drift upward at varying positions above the flame tips, suggesting detached embers. The arrangement of the logs at the base stays essentially fixed, their glow persisting without obvious collapse or shift. The brick walls and overall framing stay in place, with no apparent camera movement, and visible motion is mainly from the dancing fire and rising embers. The overall brightness and flame coverage remain roughly steady, with no clear ramp-up or fade-out visible.
